# obix-runtime-component

> Previous name: `@obinexusltd/obix-runtime-component` — OBIX packages are named without an npm scope since decision D-102 (2026-09-29); the package, its version and its exports are unchanged.

The components of OBIX's native runtime: it reads canonical DOP IR (obix-dop-ir/3) as plain data and runs it — props, state, derived values, actions, effects, the view — building and updating the DOM in place. No Vue, no React, no compiler package. Phase 6 (docs/recovery/native-runtime.md).

## Installation

```bash
npm install obix-runtime-component
```

## Basic usage

```js
import { Linker, OBIX_RUNTIME_IR, OBIX_RUNTIME_IR_SCHEMA, ObixRuntimeError } from 'obix-runtime-component';
```

## API surface

- `obix-runtime-component` — 7 value exports: `Linker`, `OBIX_RUNTIME_IR`, `OBIX_RUNTIME_IR_SCHEMA`, `ObixRuntimeError`, `mountComponent`, `pageListeners`, `readComponent`
- Type declarations: `./dist/index.d.ts` (and a declaration next to every JS entry point).

## Architecture role

`obix-runtime-component` is a **lower layer of the experimental native browser runtime** (Phase 6), which runs canonical DOP IR with no Vue. Applications reach the runtime through the umbrella `obix` (`createObixApp`, `ref`, `computed`, `watch`, D-104), which stands on `obix-runtime-browser` and `obix-runtime-reactivity`.

The architecture of OBIX — the package families and which packages are public API — is indexed in the umbrella: [docs/architecture.md](https://github.com/obinexus/obix/blob/main/docs/architecture.md).

## Package relationships

- Depends on (OBIX): [`obix-runtime-reactivity`](https://github.com/obinexus/obix-runtime-reactivity), [`obix-runtime-dom`](https://github.com/obinexus/obix-runtime-dom).
- Used by (OBIX): [`obix-runtime-browser`](https://github.com/obinexus/obix-runtime-browser).

## Testing

- 14 test files ship in the npm package (`test/`): the evidence of the package's contract, published so that its verification can be inspected — not runtime code (no entry point reaches them).
- **Standalone**: 14 of 14 — they read nothing outside the package.
- Run them with `npm test` (`node --test "test/*.test.mjs"`) in the OBIX monorepo, which provides the test tooling (Node's test runner, TypeScript) and the harness.
